全国大学生数学建模竞赛-建模与编程手 2023年09月 - 2023年09月 题目为“商超蔬菜自动定价与补货决策 ”，负责对大量题目数据进行清洗筛选并整合，并采用各种检验与Apriori算法挖掘蔬菜品类的 内在关系，对建立RFM模型对客户进行评级分类，最后构建基于随机森林TSF时间序列预测和非线性规划的蔬菜自动定价与补货决策模型； 获广东省赛区一等奖； 专业技能 计算机：Python, Java, MySQL, MongoDB, Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point

全国大学生数学建模竞赛-建模与编程手 2023年09月 - 2023年09月 题目为“商超蔬菜自动定价与补货决策 ”，负责对大量题目数据进行清洗筛选并整合，并采用各种检验与Apriori算法挖掘蔬菜品类的 内在关系，对建立RFM模型对客户进行评级分类，最后构建基于随机森林TSF时间序列预测和非线性规划的蔬菜自动定价与补货决策模型； 获广东省赛区一等奖； 专业技能 计算机：Python, Java, MySQL, MongoDB, Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point

全国大学生数学建模竞赛-建模与编程手 2023年09月 - 2023年09月 题目为“商超蔬菜自动定价与补货决策 ”，负责对大量题目数据进行清洗筛选并整合，并采用各种检验与Apriori算法挖掘蔬菜品类的 内在关系，对建立RFM模型对客户进行评级分类，最后构建基于随机森林TSF时间序列预测和非线性规划的蔬菜自动定价与补货决策模型； 获广东省赛区一等奖； 专业技能 计算机：Python, Java, MySQL, MongoDB, Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point

实习经历 新产业创投(序明基金)-量化研究实习生 2025年11月 - 至今 端到端因子挖掘与表征学习：复现基于 Transformer 的量化研报框架，引入前向收益预测与后向特征重建（forward prediction & backward reconstruction）构建自监督学习任务，将日内分钟级交易与价格特征压缩为日度“量化指纹”；搭建高效的数据处理与训 练 Pipeline（多频对齐、缺失值处理、特征标准化、掩码机制），支持大规模样本训练与迭代实验。 建模与因子有效性验证：基于量化指纹构建 GRU/LSTM 时序模型，进行横截面收益预测；通过分层回测（quantile backtesting）、 多空组合分析、IC/RankIC 评估信号预测能力，并结合因子分组表现、稳定性（IC decay）及 Beta/行业暴露分析，系统评估因子鲁棒 性与风险特征。 组合构建与风险约束优化：将模型输出映射为交易信号，构建简易指数增强组合（index enhancement）；在换手率、行业/风格暴 露、个股权重等约束下进行组合优化，分析 Alpha 来源、收益归因及风险调整后表现（如 Sharpe、最大回撤），验证策略的可实盘 性。 FinaDina-风控模型实习生 数智实验室 2025年07月 - 2025年11月 图网络反欺诈建模：构建客户关系图谱以识别关联方风险，设计并落地基于团伙的黑名单规则，用于有组织信贷欺诈的离线分析与实时 拦截；累计识别70+欺诈团伙，拦截200+异常信贷申请。 特征工程与建模：搭建自动化短信标注流程，结合大模型（LLM）辅助标注与 BERT 分类模型识别外部借贷机构短信；将文本特征接入 XGBoost/CatBoost 模型，推动 AUC 从约0.62提升至约0.67，KS 从约0.16提升至约0.18。 特征稳定性监控：构建并维护 PSI 监控看板，跟踪核心与衍生特征的分布漂移，在生产环境中持续监控人群稳定性，支持模型风险管 理。 富卫集团-数据科学家实习生 DataPlatform 2024年10月 - 2025年07月 数据处理Pipeline : 负责保险客户、代理人的属性和行为数据的预处理与特征工程，使用 Python 构建自动化数据清洗 Pipeline，处理 缺失值、异常值和冗余特征，确保数据质量。在 Azure Data Lake 和 Databricks 上，通过 Pyspark 查询和构建特征，提升数据处理速 度，为后续模型训练提供数据基础。 保险欺诈检测 : 负责保险欺诈风险预测模型的构建与优化，采用 XGBoost 等模型进行建模，并通过特征工程提升模型表现。结合 Louvain 算法进行社区检测，识别潜在欺诈团伙并完善标签体系，结合Smote有效缓解样本不平衡问题，模型 AUC 提升至 0.93。 智能话术 Workflow 搭建：搭建保险产品信息文本的知识向量库 ,并利用 LangChain 构建保险电销话术评估工作流。工作流可自动将 销售通话内容转为文本，并对保险产品信息进行索引后对话术进行结构化分析与打标，实现销售过程的自动评估与优化建议生成。 关联分析与转化漏斗建模 : 针对保险电销数据，应用 Apriori 算法 挖掘高频产品组合与客户特征关联规则，优化销售策略。结合 Funnel Analysis 构建客户转化漏斗模型，识别关键转化节点与流失原因，为业务团队提供数据驱动的决策依据。 广州钛动科技有限公司-数据分析实习生 增长管理中心 2023年08月 - 2024年03月 仪表盘制作：通过SQL联合多表查询，从数据库中提取并清洗每周客户消费信息，进行多维度的聚合分析。利用Tableau与SQL的集 成，构建业务数据监控仪表盘，实时展示关键业务指标，为管理层提供决策支持。 客户评级建模：基于末次消费、消费频次及消费额度三个关键维度，构建RFM模型，量化广告主的价值。应用K-means, T-SNE等聚类 算法，对广告主进行评级与细分管理。 广告投放效果分析：Python 与 SQL 对广告投放数据进行归因分析，评估不同渠道（Google Ads、Facebook、TikTok Ads）的ROI与 转化贡献，识别高潜客群与高效素材组合。 项目经历 美国大学生数学建模竞赛-建模与编程手 2024年01月 - 2024年01月 采集境外野生动物合法与非法贸易记录，对数据筛选整合后，使用Stata和Python建立VAR模型进行时间序列分析，并构建演化博弈模 型推算政策策略的影响，最后给出政策建议，以及输出完整论文；最终获得M奖; 全国大学生数学建模竞赛-建模与编程手 2023年09月 - 2023年09月 题目为“商超蔬菜自动定价与补货决策 ”，负责对大量题目数据进行清洗筛选并整合，并采用各种检验与Apriori算法挖掘蔬菜品类的 内在关系，对建立RFM模型对客户进行评级分类，最后构建基于随机森林TSF时间序列预测和非线性规划的蔬菜自动定价与补货决策模型； 获广东省赛区一等奖； 专业技能 计算机：Python, Java, MySQL, MongoDB, Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point

jobCards.raw_jd_text: About Deloitte: When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award. Our Purpose Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations and supporting our communities. Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact: Lead the way Serve with integrity Take care of each other Foster inclusion Collaborate for measurable impact Audit & Assurance – Experienced Associate During your tenure as an Experienced Associate in Audit & Assurance, you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas: Have knowledge of relevant accounting standards applicable to the entity and perform risk assessment procedures to provide a basis for the identification and assessments of the risks of material misstatement. Delivery of high-quality audits via a number of enablers like Global Audit Imperatives, methodology, content, guidance, learning and other tools. Formulate reasonable judgements and conclusions in order to deliver informative and timely outputs. Compliance with auditing and accounting standards, relevant laws and regulations (including specific local laws and regulations), ethical standards, independence requirements and the audit firm's quality control procedures. Leadership capabilities: Build own understanding of our purpose and values; explore opportunities for impact. Demonstrates strong commitment to personal learning and development; acts as a brand ambassador to help attract top talent. Understands expectations and demonstrates personal accountability for keeping performance on track. Actively focuses on developing effective communication and relationship-building skills. Understands how their daily work contributes to the priorities of the team and the business. Qualifications Degree in Accounting, Auditing or related field. Strong academic credential. 2-3 years of experience in Accounting, Auditing, or any related field. Demonstrated leadership, problem solving, and strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to prioritize tasks and work on multiple assignments. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Fluent in English (Reading, Speaking and Writing). Preference will be given to Bilingual candidates (Arabic/English).

jobCards.raw_jd_text: Full job description Job Summary To track and monitor financial and non-financial data, to ensure the accuracy of the information that goes into the management and reporting of all financial results of the Middle East and South East Asia based sites. To provide data analysis of financial information in support of the Regional Management Accountant and Regional Finance Director as required. To analyse data, solve problems and prepare reports as required. To manage projects that may involve data collection, problem solving analysis, business efficiency reviews. To use and manipulate the data and systems to prepare financial models for budgeting and forecasting To provide financial analysis and KPI reporting for the Regional Team as required. Review of the information and data within the systems and identifying areas for the Regional Management Accountants attention. Ensure accuracy of data going into the systems and the output. Production of the management and reporting packs linked to the various systems, and ultimately linked to TM1 Cognos reporting package. Continually develop and improve management information reports for the other sites and management. Problem solving with the schools data and identifying solutions. Produce reports to measure efficiencies and build comparisons between schools for management reporting. To assist the team in the preparation of annual budgets, regular forecasts and cash flow forecasts with particular focus on financial modelling and reports. Meeting tight deadlines set by the group. Any task as deemed reasonable by the Regional Management Accountant. Required Skills Experience and proven ability in a Data Analyst role with excellent excel and excellent presentation skills for the purpose of reporting for financial and non-financial people. Experience and proven ability in data analysis and planning. Experience in accountancy software products such as Navision, Oracle, SAGE, and/or other financial systems. Microsoft Office is required with excellent Excel skills. Particular experience in using datawarehouse systems and reporting systems. The group use TM1, an IBM Cognos system. The ability to work to tight deadlines, and the ability to gather, analyse, explain and consolidate data for management reporting. Some accounting knowledge is desirable but not essential.

experience_required.description: Experience and proven ability in a Data Analyst role with excellent Excel and presentation skills for financial and non-financial reporting. Experience in data analysis and planning. Experience with accountancy software such as Navision, Oracle, SAGE, or other financial systems. Experience using data warehouse and reporting systems, particularly TM1 (IBM Cognos). Ability to work to tight deadlines and consolidate data for management reporting. Some accounting knowledge desirable but not essential.

must_have: Experience with accountancy software (Navision, Oracle, SAGE, or similar)
Experience with data warehouse and reporting systems
Ability to gather, analyse, explain and consolidate data

jd_profile.job_summary: Responsible for tracking and monitoring financial and non-financial data to ensure accuracy in management and reporting of financial results for Middle East and South East Asia sites. Provide data analysis to support Regional Management Accountant and Regional Finance Director. Manage projects involving data collection, problem solving, and business efficiency reviews. Prepare financial models for budgeting and forecasting. Produce management and reporting packs linked to TM1 Cognos system. Continuously improve management information reports and assist in budget and cash flow forecast preparation.
jd_profile.key_challenge: Ensuring accuracy of data input and output within multiple financial systems, meeting tight deadlines, and producing reliable financial models and reports to support regional management decisions.
